meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器内装好固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI 和一个容器技能,让 agent 能读取容器里的 Word、PPT、Excel 等办公文档,在本地转成 Markdown,不经过托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取容器里附件的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档,又不希望把这些文件上传到托管解析服务时,由它接管转换。

say.text: 把这个 XLSX 附件转成 Markdown 表格。
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不用于计算。

say.text: 这个纯图片 PDF 转不了就直说,别上传。

howto.what_en: Installs a pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI plus a container skill so NanoClaw agents convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and other office files to Markdown locally inside the container, without uploading them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent needs to read attached Word, PowerPoint or Excel files from the container and the files must not be uploaded to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the DOCX in /workspace/inbox to Markdown and summarize it.
Turn this XLSX attachment into a Markdown table.
say_en.note: Markdown tables aren't authoritative for calculations.

say_en.text: If this image-only PDF can't be converted, say so and don't upload it.
